description: Applies the style (Props) previously copied into WireframeClipboard to the selected elements. Undoable. The component registry is needed to know which props are style props for each element type.

members.name: PasteStyleCommand
members.type: PasteStyleCommand(WireframeDocument doc, IEnumerable<string> ids, WireframeComponentRegistry registry)
members.description: Creates the command for the selected element ids.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable label shown in undo/redo tooltips.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Applies the change to the document.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Restores the state captured before Execute() ran.
